evidence.source: Exact predict help from the digest-pinned SIF
evidence.observation: The pinned predict command exposes exactly nine option keys: pdb, checkpoint, output, chains, positions, device, config, quiet, and help.

evidence.source: Exact CLI version from the digest-pinned SIF

evidence.observation: FRUSTRAMPNN_RUNTIME_IDENTITY pins the image, executable, MegaScale checkpoint, package version, source commit, and their SHA-256 identities.

predict_options.default_source: The owning workflow or governed upload supplies an immutable source artifact; BMS resolves it to a snapshot rather than accepting a host path.
predict_options.disposition_reason: The model requires a structure, while BMS owns path resolution, snapshotting, and source hashing.

predict_options.value_contract: Required model checkpoint file ending in .ckpt
predict_options.disposition_reason: BMS authenticates and fixes megascale.ckpt; an operator-supplied checkpoint would break the pinned capability identity.

predict_options.value_contract: Output CSV file; model-native default is frustration_predictions.csv
predict_options.default_source: The scheduler allocates a path below the job-owned output root.
predict_options.disposition_reason: Output placement is storage and security policy, not a scientific control.

predict_options.value_contract: Comma-separated chain IDs; model-native default is all chains
predict_options.default_source: All protein entities unless a complete typed source-backed selection is supplied.
predict_options.disposition_reason: Chain selection changes which residues are scored and therefore requires typed human and agent control.

predict_options.value_contract: Comma-separated zero-based positions; model-native default is all positions
predict_options.default_source: All scoreable positions unless source-authoritative residue references are selected and resolved to zero-based model positions.
predict_options.disposition_reason: Position selection changes which residues are scored and therefore requires a typed residue selector rather than free text.

predict_options.value_contract: Closed choice cuda or cpu; model-native default is auto-detect
predict_options.default_source: The scheduler assigns a physical GPU and the runtime compiler uses task-visible cuda device 0.
predict_options.disposition_reason: Physical resource assignment is scheduler-owned; the product must not permit operators to select host device IDs or CPU fallback.

predict_options.value_contract: Optional config file for old-format checkpoints
predict_options.default_source: Absent for the pinned MegaScale checkpoint.
predict_options.disposition_reason: Pinned help limits this option to old-format checkpoints, while the authenticated MegaScale checkpoint does not require it.

predict_options.value_contract: Boolean flag that suppresses the progress bar
predict_options.default_source: BMS runtime compiler fixed policy: omitted (false).
predict_options.disposition_reason: Progress presentation does not alter scientific output and remains a fixed diagnostics policy.

predict_options.value_contract: Boolean CLI documentation flag that prints help and exits
predict_options.default_source: CLI framework behavior only; never part of a model execution request.
predict_options.disposition_reason: The flag exists only to display command documentation and terminate without inference.
